question: Can I lick the syrup off of Nami's body? Shimizu
answer: It's you again, you pervert!! You keep ruining the morals of this manga!! But hang on!! I feel like the handwriting on this postcard is different!! Did you always have such nice handwriting?! You better not be an imposter!! If this isn't the real Chamoro...you can go. No, you can't!!! Don't send me these postcards, whoever you are!!
name: Chamoro Shimizu
